info.title: PCB Inspection Service
info.description:
Compares a photo of a printed circuit board with a reference photo of the same board side,
returns the differing regions and collects operator feedback on them as a training dataset.

All coordinates are pixels of the uploaded image after EXIF orientation is applied.
Errors are returned as RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

post.description: Upload a reference photo for one side. It becomes the active reference of that side.
Make the photo of an existing inspection the active reference of its side (no re-upload).

Queue a photo of one board side for comparison with the reference. Poll ``poll_url`` for the result.

Retrying with the same ``Idempotency-Key`` returns the inspection created by the first request.
